text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — elevated 95th/99th latency on /v1/generate, error spike (503). Possible KV cache growth + batching spike. Severity: P2.

maria: taking pager, oncall here. starting triage. any recent deploys?

raj: yep, there was a runtime rollout ~2h ago that adjusted continuous batching params (batch_timeout 5ms -> 50ms). seeing cache size ramp in metrics around the same time.

simon: confirmed the rollout. the new batching increases queued requests for longer which looks like it delays KV cache warmups.

kelly: customers reporting 5-10s tail latencies and intermittent 503s from the gateway. support tickets coming in.

alice: which metric is triggering HPA? cpu or custom?

raj: HPA is CPU-based; long queues + batching keep GPUs/CPUs busy, HPA scales up, cold pods then spike CPU on warmup -> scale down when metrics drop -> thrash.

maria: that explains the oscillation. we have autoscale feedback loop because of the batching change.

raj: snapshot from metrics: `kv_cache_bytes` doubled in 12m, `batch_queue_length` spiked to 800, cpu utilization moved 70% -> 95% triggering HPA. logs show pod churn.

simon: mitigation suggestions: immediate rollback of the batching change to previous values (restore batch_timeout=5ms), and add HPA stabilizationWindow/minReplicas temporarily.

maria: agree. i'm going to rollback batching config now and also ask infra to hold scale-downs for a bit.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollback-batching-config v2 -> v1 by maria

raj: patching HPA: setting spec.behavior.scaleDown.stabilizationWindowSeconds=300 and minReplicas=currentReplicaCount to prevent rapid scale-down.

kelly: I'm adding temporary dashboard panels: per-pod cache warmup time, batch queue length, and recent scale events.

maria: FYI sending a short message to customer success with ETA and mitigation steps.

alice: customers affected: tenant: acme-inc, tenant: beta-saas. support already engaged and set to notify status page if persisted.

simon: rollback confirmed applied. batch_timeout restored to 5ms. pods show reduced queue lengths.

raj: HPA patch applied. minReplicas locked to 4, stabilizationWindow 300s. hope this stops thrash while cache stabilizes.

kelly: metrics update: batch_queue_length down from 800 -> 40 in last 90s. 95th latency dropping from ~4.8s -> ~600ms. error rate trending down.

maria: nice. I'll keep pager open until stable for 15m.

raj: observed one scale event 2m after the rollback but then stable. no further downscales in 7m.

simon: quick note for follow-up: the runtime kernel selection interacts with batch_timeout in non-linear ways — need an eval on default for different seq lengths.

maria: agreed. follow-up tasks: (1) postmortem + timeline, (2) evaluate default batch_timeout and canary rollout gating, (3) consider HPA using queue-length or gpu-util instead of CPU for this workload. assigning simon/raj to investigation.

alice: customer success updated two tenants with mitigation details and workaround.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: rollback-batching-config v1 at commit abc123

kelly: putting a short note on the status board and leaving the dashboard pinned.

maria: closing pager in 10m if stable. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident resolved for thread 1893500000 — KV cache + batching regression caused autoscale thrash and increased tail latency. Severity: P2. Follow-up: simon, raj, maria.

maria: postmortem owners acknowledged. I'll draft initial timeline and action items.

simon: ping me if you need logs or a reproduction harness. I have a small script to simulate batch_timeout changes against our perf tests.

raj: after-action item: add HPA docs for stabilizationWindow and recommend minReplicas config for runtime pools.

maria: thanks all, closing thread.
